status: Locally verified source increment after published SDK/runtime 0.13.0. No new release or deployment in this increment. Full parity remains open.

upstream.contract: Default cooked VINTR/VQUIT/VSUSP signal the foreground group without input bytes or caret echo. With no foreground group, caret echo and an empty line wake the reader. Raw mode preserves bytes.

implementation.routing: Existing queue_signal process-family scheduler, signal masks/dispositions, wait statuses and restart frames. A bounded three-signal bitset is drained at accepted native input writes. The no-signal path returns immediately.
implementation.persistence: The existing R2 input head/chunks retain accepted control bytes and offsets. Terminal and process state live in the existing same-build native heap checkpoint. No new external operation, storage namespace, migration or infrastructure resource.

focusedFirstRun.command: bun test tests/tty-signals.test.ts tests/pty-recovery.test.ts tests/pty.test.ts tests/pty-session.test.ts
focusedFirstRun.failure: The new recovery fixture expected initial echo before its ready marker. Native execution emits ready before its first blocking read, then accepts initial input. Only the expected prefix was corrected; no product change, assertion removal or timeout increase.

cases: Handled SIGINT/SIGQUIT/SIGTSTP interrupt tty reads; exact input retries do not duplicate handlers.
SA_RESTART keeps the pending tty read until a later complete line.
Default SIGINT and SIGQUIT exit with 130 and 131.
Raw mode preserves 03 1c 1a ff exactly with no signals.
Ignored and blocked signals consume control bytes and clear the unfinished line; unblocking invokes retained handlers.
Read-only and wrong-sandbox capabilities fail before control input publication.
Ctrl-Z stops the foreground child; a native parent observes WUNTRACED, SIGCONT and WCONTINUED, then Ctrl-C exits that child. A child in another group remains active until explicit cleanup.
Same-build R2 checkpoint/replacement retains the partial line and pending read. A later Ctrl-C clears the old line once; later bytes/EOF and duplicate Queue delivery retain exact output and offsets.

benchmark.limits: Maintained local workerd regression workload, without a paired reference run. It is not a PTY-specific latency, cold-start, peak memory, production billing or AgentOS comparison. The prior maintained performance evidence was preserved.
